Awesome cooking class
Aug 2026 • Couples
We had a very exciting private cooking class with Linh and her family. Don't book one of those overpriced "GetYourGuide" classes - instead, spend your money directly with these hospitable, welcoming, and wonderful families, without paying a commission fee to a third-party platform.

After a welcome drink, you get a short basket boat ride - far away from the noisy and crowded party boat tours you get directly in the city. In fact, we were completely alone the entire time! Linh’s father paddled us to the nearby shore, where he skillfully crafted two different rings out of water coconut leaves.

After this short trip, we returned to the restaurant, where our class started. We prepared four different meals: BBQ mushroom, a savory pancake with spring onion and soybean sprouts, eggplant clay pot, tofu salad (when we booked the class, we opted for the vegetarian meals). The ingredients, partly from her own garden, were fresh and therefore smelled and tasted wonderful. What made this whole class awesome was that Linh was always with us and guiding us through the preparation step-by-step, which was only possible due to the fact that it was only the two of us attending it. We had already attended one cooking class back in Thailand, and that was a very different story when cooking together with 10 other people (pretty stressful - you get the preparation shown once and have to memorize everything).

The outcome of each meal was fabulous, very tasty, and rich in flavors; we enjoyed every bite of our own creations. We will definitely try to prepare those dishes back at home!

We had a lot of fun cooking with Linh and were almost sad when we left her. We had a wonderful experience and can only recommend this to anyone visiting Hoi An and searching for a unique experience away from the crowds.

Terrible Chef
Apr 2026 • Couples
We had lunch at this restaurant at the end of April. We initially ordered a grilled fish and grilled prawns. Its small grilling station is in the open air and close to the restaurant tables. When the chef cum owner cum waiter had put the fish and prawns on the grilling grate, I went over and requested the chef politely that we liked the fish and prawns not to be overcooked and there was no need to put any sauce on the fish. Unexpectedly, he shouted back rudely “I know, I know”. We consider this a reasonable request as overcooked seafoods would be dry and no good to taste. We were the one to eat them and pay for them. Then I simply walked away to avoid any argument.
After a period of time, I went back again and saw that both the fish and prawns had been overcooked and suggested to the chef that they could be served. Again, he shouted “I cook or you cook, 2 more minutes”. I walked away again.
When the fish and prawns were served, they were obviously overcooked and the meat were dry. We did not complain about this. We then ordered two more items- spring rolls and fried noodles.
When we asked for the bill, we told the chef that he should be more polite to us as guests and listen to the guests’ reasonable request. He lost his temper and shouted “I don’t like to talk to you and don’t like to see you again”. We tried to explain to him our position as the restaurant guests, but he refused to listen and repeated the same message. His wife came out from the kitchen and could not control him. We then tried to explain to his wife on what had happened. She replied that we should not raise the request at the grilling station, but at the table, claiming that I interfered his cooking. We told her that there was no other waiter and it was the most direct communication.
This was the first time that we encountered such a rude, impolite and unfriendly owner/chef/waiter worldwide. I can say that restaurants around the world, including high end ones, welcome guests’ expression of their food preference and would try their best to cook the foods to their liking. Throughout our many years of travelling in Vietnam, most restaurant staff who we met were friendly and provided good service. This restaurant owner cum chef is a rare exception. He is a very emotional person.
